examples.title: Fake PayPal Verification Email
examples.description: A message claiming your PayPal account is limited, designed to pressure you into entering your login details on a lookalike site.

examples.title: Fake Package Delivery Email
examples.description: A shipping notice that asks for a small “redelivery fee” to reschedule a package you weren't expecting — a common way to collect payment card details.

examples.title: Fake Shared Document Email
examples.description: A notification claiming a file has been shared with you, using urgency and a fake sign-in page to steal your email password.

examples.title: Fake “Boss” Gift Card Request
examples.description: A rushed, secretive message impersonating an executive who's suddenly unreachable and asks you to buy gift cards on their behalf.

examples.title: Fake Unusual Login Alert
examples.description: A security alert about a sign-in from an unfamiliar location, pressuring you to “verify your identity” by re-entering your password.

examples.title: Fake Benefits Enrollment Email
examples.description: A message posing as HR, threatening a loss of health coverage unless you resubmit personal and bank details through a deadline-driven link.

examples.title: Fake Government Agency Email
examples.description: A message impersonating a tax agency, threatening legal action and asking for gift cards and a Social Security number to “resolve” a balance.
